# Dorza

> Dorza is a two-founder team in Sydney that looks after the tech for small businesses across Australia. We help a business start (website, hosting, Google profile), grow (search, booking systems, dashboards) and stay supported (hosting, updates and changes after launch). No lock-in.

## Who Dorza is for

Owner-run Australian small businesses with nobody looking after their tech.

## What Dorza does

### Start
- Website and hosting: a site designed for the business and built by hand.
- Google Business Profile setup.
- On request: domain and business email, brand basics.

### Grow
- SEO and content.
- Custom builds such as online booking systems and admin dashboards.
- On request: social media, paid ads, online stores, CRM setup.

### Support
- Hosting and updates.
- Changes on request, by the people who built the site.
- On request: Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 setup.

## Service pages

Live means Dorza takes it on now. On request means ask first.

- Online stores, usually Shopify (on request): https://www.dorza.com.au/services/online-store

- Google Ads (on request): https://www.dorza.com.au/services/google-ads
- Domain and business email on Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 (on request): https://www.dorza.com.au/services/business-email
- Social media (on request): https://www.dorza.com.au/services/social-media-management
- All services, grouped by stage: https://www.dorza.com.au/services

## Pricing

Websites start from $499. Larger builds are quoted. Every enquiry gets an exact plan and price within 72 hours. There is no lock-in, and the client owns what is built.

## Work

- Drivable (https://www.dorza.com.au/work/drivable): website and booking system for a wheelchair accessible vehicle and 4WD hire business in Sydney.
- Active Rise Health (https://www.dorza.com.au/work/active-rise-health): practice website for a physio working across two clinics and home visits in Western Sydney, with a pathway for referrers.
